label: SYNTHETIC verification kernel - NOT a ground-motion prediction equation
WARNING: These numbers are invented. They are not taken from any publication and do not approximate any published GMPE. They exist so the framework in model.py - log-base handling, unit conversion, period and damping grids, required-field validation, extrapolation policy, and the lognormal kernel - can be tested WITHOUT fabricating coefficients for any of the 30 benchmark models. Never use this for hazard assessment. Every prediction it produces carries a SYNTHETIC warning, and asset.ttl excludes it from cap:validityScope.
functional_form: log10 Y = a(T)*M + b(T)*R - log10(R) + c(T, site_class)
form_note: A generic attenuation shape chosen because it exercises log10 and cm/s2 together. It is deliberately NOT any specific model's form.

provenance.citation: None. There is nothing to cite.
provenance.tau_phi_note: tau and phi are in log10 units, consistent with log_base. sigma_total is derived as sqrt(tau^2 + phi^2); the wrapper records that it was derived rather than published.
